**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no take-or-pay exposure for us:

- **No commitment language anywhere** — searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "non-cancellable", "volume" return nothing on point (the sole "commitment" hit is the no-agency clause at p0143).
- **§11 Fees (p0084)** — fees payable only as set out in the Fee Schedule; **§2 (p0028)** makes additional fees contingent on *our* election to use the Software beyond Authorized Locations.
- **§10 (p0065)** — maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term, not a fixed multi-year obligation.
- **§17(b) (p0118)** — we hold an unconditional termination-for-convenience right on 90 days' notice, so even the perpetual fee-paying structure in §17(a) carries a clean exit.

This sits at the **preferred** position (fees for usage or ordered services only), not merely the fallback.

One residual item flagged in the rationale rather than as a deviation: Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule) is referenced throughout but not reproduced in the text available. Since that schedule is where any committed user/location counts or minimum annual maintenance spend would live, it is worth confirming the schedule itself before treating this rule as fully closed.
